responsibility: Implements value_range_equiv, GCC’s legacy VRP range object that extends a normal value_range with a bitmap of SSA-name equivalences. This file manages deep-copy and move behavior for the bitmap, updates and validation of range/equivalence state, lattice meet and intersection rules that combine both bounds and equivalence sets, and dump/debug support, providing the concrete behavior used by vr-values.c when classic value range propagation tracks not only numeric bounds but also names known to share the same value.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementation of the value_range_equiv class declared in gcc/value-range-equiv.h, including bitmap ownership, deep-copy/move behavior, meet/intersection rules, validation, and dumping for SSA-name equivalence tracking.
